Name: Prawnguin's Sterling Portrait
Author: Prawnguin
Description:
[b]Current version has:[/b]
[list]
[*]4 portraits for Sterling (1 for each season).
[/list]
[b]Future plans:[/b]
[list]
[*]Henry and Mia seasonal lite portraits.
[*]Portraits for other characters used in ARV.
[/list]
-----

[b]How to Install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Ensure you have all the required mods.
[*]Extract the .zip file into your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder, separate from the main Always Raining in the Valley mod.
[*]In the main Always Raining in the Valley mod, edit the configuration for "SeasonalsLite", and set it to "true", and "Nyapu's Portraits" to "false". Otherwise, the portraits will be inconsistent, or will not show up.
[/list]
-----

Thank you so much to Lemurkat and Abagaianye for helping me figure out the code for this!

Sterling belongs to the author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts/mods]HimeTarts[/url]. Thank you so much for the amazing story and characters, and for allowing me to create this! :>>
